parsed.rationale: Three separate packages — DebugPanel and Wallpaper (twice, once in a sample-app path and once in production throttling code) — each define an unnamed extension on ProcessInfo.ThermalState at lines 212, 236, and 230 respectively. Because all three context-flag sets are false (not test, not codegen, not mock, not sample-app flagged), these are live production extensions that shadow one another. The canonical home is DebugPanel, which already owns the first copy; the two Wallpaper copies should be deleted and Wallpaper should import DebugPanel (or a shared utility package) to consume the single extension. If a circular-dependency concern prevents Wallpaper from importing DebugPanel, the extension should instead be lifted into a shared lower-level package that both already depend on.
